mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user (username, password, phone, nickname, avatar_path, role, status) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{phone}, #{nickname}, #{avatarPath}, #{role}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET username = #{username}, password = #{password}, phone = #{phone}, nickname = #{nickname}, avatar_path = #{avatarPath}, role = #{role}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password, phone, nickname, avatar_path, role, status, created_at, updated_at FROM sys_user WHERE phone = #{phone} ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT id, username, password, phone, nickname, avatar_path, role, status, created_at, updated_at FROM sys_user ORDER BY id DESC
